title: Supabase Overview & Architecture
content: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative built on PostgreSQL, providing real-time database subscriptions, instant REST/GraphQL APIs, Auth, and Storage.

title: Supabase Database CRUD Operations
content:
Perform CRUD in Supabase using `@supabase/supabase-js`:
• Create: `const { data } = await supabase.from('todos').insert([{ task: 'Buy milk' }])`
• Read: `const { data } = await supabase.from('todos').select('*').eq('completed', false)`
• Update: `const { data } = await supabase.from('todos').update({ completed: true }).eq('id', 1)`
• Delete: `const { data } = await supabase.from('todos').delete().eq('id', 1)`.

title: Supabase Authentication & Row Level Security (RLS)
content: Supabase provides built-in email/password, OAuth, and Magic Link authentication. Secure data using PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) policies: `CREATE POLICY "Users can view own data" ON todos FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id)`.
